descriptionPlaceholder: Who is this character? Appearance, background, world...
descriptionHint: Always included in the prompt -- put everything important here.
personalityHint: Always included as a "Personality:" line after the description.
scenarioPlaceholder: The situation and setting the conversation starts in.
scenarioHint: Included as a "Scenario:" line after the description.
greetingPlaceholder: *She looks up from her notes* You made it.
greetingHint: The character's opening message. It sets the tone and length of every reply after it.
exampleDialogueHint: Optional. Blocks starting with <START> demonstrate how the character speaks and are dropped first when context runs low.
systemPromptOverrideHint: Replaces the composed prompt entirely when set. Leave empty unless the card ships its own.
deleteConfirmationDesc: This removes the character. Existing chats keep working but lose their link to it.
defaultDesc: Used for new chats when nothing else was selected recently.
yourNameDesc: Substituted for {{user}} in prompts so characters know what to call you.
